stability_gate.reason: Both unseen years improved in mean, but pooled race-bootstrap 95% CI still crosses zero.

interpretation: Directional decomposition is more promising than global/local absolute-gap correction, but is not statistically stable enough to freeze as a production probability layer.
UP_ONLY has negative mean delta in both years but pooled 95% CI still crosses zero.
DOWN_ONLY is unstable by year: worse in 2024, better in 2025.
MIXED remains effectively disabled with alpha=0 in both years.
Segment diagnostics reveal heterogeneity, but outcome-defined segments such as winning-ticket odds bands must remain diagnostics only and must not be converted into betting rules.
next: Do not promote directional probability correction. Move to L2B value research with MARKET_RAW as the canonical probability baseline and Directional/King/Outsider signals as auxiliary features; evaluate edge/ROI walk-forward without filtering to tiny hand-picked cells.
